Add the lentils into the mixture.
Add the vegetable stock and water into the pan.
Mix the soup well.
Place a lid on top of the pan.
Cook the soup for ten to fifteen minutes.
Dish out the soup when the lentils are done.
Garnish the dish with chopped parsley on top.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Meatballs
method: Take a large bowl.
Add the beef mince, spices, mint, onion, garlic, and egg into the bowl.
Mix all the ingredients well and form round ball structures.
Fry the meatballs in olive oil until they turn golden brown.
Dish out the meatballs.
Serve the meatballs with Greek yoghurt on the side.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Milk Custard Pudding

ingredients.item: A quarter teaspoon of cinnamon powder

method: Take a large saucepan.
Add the water and whole milk.
Let the liquid boil for five minutes.
Add the egg yolks and sugar into the milk mixture.
Cook all the ingredients well for thirty minutes or until it starts to get
thick.
Keep stirring continuously.
Add the cinnamon powder on top.
The dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek olive salad with herb vinaigrette
intro: For this classic, deeply refreshing combination, choose tasty, pungent Kalamata olives and firm tomatoes, as well as an aromatic, strong extra-virgin olive oil for the vinaigrette.

ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper
green bell peppers, cored, seeded, and diced
(For the dressing) of mint, leaves picked and finely chopped
(For the dressing) of oregano, leaves picked and finely chopped
(For the dressing) of parsley, leaves picked and finely chopped

method: To make the vinaigrette, gradually whisk the oil into the vinegar so that the mixture emulsifies and thickens slightly. Add the herbs, whisk again, and season to taste.
Cut each cucumber in half lengthwise. Scoop out the seeds with a teaspoon. Discard the seeds. Cut the cucumbers lengthwise into strips, then into 1⁄2 in (1cm) slices.
Core the tomatoes, cut each into 8 wedges, then cut each wedge in half. Slice the onion into very thin rings, then gently separate the concentric circles within each ring.

Put the cucumbers, tomatoes, onion rings, and peppers in a large bowl. Briskly whisk the dressing and pour it over. Add the olives and feta, toss to coat, and season. Allow the flavors to mellow for about 30 minutes before serving.

name: Greek Omelet Casserole

ingredients.item: Eight ounces of freshly cut spinach
One cup of crumbled feta cheese

method: Take a large bowl.
Add the eggs into the bowl.
Beat the eggs for about five minutes.
Take another bowl and add the pepper, lemon pepper, fresh dill,
dried oregano, and salt into the bowl.
Mix all the ingredients well.
Add the olive oil and spinach into the egg bowl.
Mix the ingredients well and add the chopped garlic and the rest
of the ingredients.
Mix all the ingredients of both the bowls together.
Add the mixture to a greased baking dish.
Bake the casserole for twenty-five to thirty minutes.
Dish out the casserole when done.
The dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Omelette
method: In a non-stick dish, heat the olive oil.
Add the spinach, tomatoes, olives, and onions and cook for three
minutes.
In a pan, stir in the eggs, sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Spoon the mixture of eggs into the pan.
Place the bowl and cook till the base is formed on the egg.
Spray on top of the omelet with fresh basil and feta.
Flip it in half with the knife.
Pick and eat hot on a tray.

name: Greek Orange Blossom Baklava

ingredients.item: Half cup of chopped nuts (of your choice)
A teaspoon of a ground orange powder

method: Take a large bowl.
Add the butter into it and beat well.
Add the nuts, orange powder, and honey into the butter bowl.
Mix the ingredients well.
Add the dried mint into the bowl and mix well.
Spread the phyllo sheets in a greased baking tray.
Add the nut mixture into the phyllo sheets and cover it with more
phyllo sheets.
Bake the baklava for about forty minutes.
Add sugar and water to a saucepan and cook.
Dish out the baklava and cut it into pieces.
Pour the sugar syrup on top of the baklava
Dish out the baklava.
The dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Orange Cake
method: Take a large bowl.
Add the cake batter and mix all the ingredients.
Make the batter and pour it into a baking dish.
Make sure the baking dish is properly greased and lined with parchment
paper.
Bake the cake.
Dish it out when done.
Cut the cake into slices.
The dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Orzo Pasta Salad with Vegan Feta
method: Take a saucepan and add the water in it.
Boil the water and add the orzo pasta into it.
Drain the orzo pasta when done.
Add the rest of the ingredients into the pasta.
Mix everything well.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Pasta Salad
method: Bring a big pot halfway with water and bring to the boil over medium
temperature, lightly salted.
When the water boils, add the penne and bring it back to a boil.
Heat the pasta uncovered, mixing periodically, for 11 minutes, or until
it is heated through and still strong to the touch.
Drain well with a colander placed in the sink after rinsing with cold
water.
Combine the vinegar, lime juice, cloves, oregano, pepper, salt, and
vegetable oil in a mixing bowl.
In a big mixing bowl, combine the spaghetti, tomatoes, onion, red and
green beans, cucumber, artichokes, and feta cheese.
Combine the spaghetti and vinaigrette in a mixing bowl.
Before serving, cover and relax for 3 hours.

name: Greek Pita Bread Bites
method: Cut the pita bread into bite-size pieces.
Dip it in all-purpose flour.
Take a large frying pan.
Add oil into the pan and heat well.
Add the pita bread and deep fry until they turn golden brown.
Dish out the bread and add the salsa and feta cheese on top.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Potato Breakfast Skillet
method: Prepare the potato as per the box instructions, stirring the spice
package with two tablespoons of olive oil.
Over moderate flame, heat a large sauté pan.
Stir in the potatoes, then simmer for two minutes.
Mix in the tomatoes and simmer until the potatoes begin to yellow
and the tomatoes begin to peel, stirring periodically.
To one bottom of the plate, move the tomatoes and potatoes and add
the remaining two teaspoons' olive oil.
Transfer the cloves and spinach to the olive oil.
Cook for about two minutes, stirring continuously until the spinach is
wilting.
Free from the heat. Mix in the pine nuts, coriander, and feta.
Cook the eggs, crispy side up, in a small nonstick pan while the
potatoes and tomato combination is frying.
Divide the mixture of potatoes into four plates.
Cover with a fried egg for each meal.
Chapter 3: Best Greek Lunch Recipes

name: Greek Rice Pudding

ingredients.item: 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons milk

method: Combine water, rice and cinnamon stick in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer covered for 16 minutes.
Add the sugar, milk and cornstarch mixture to the pan.
Increase the heat to moderate and constantly stir 16 minutes, until the mixture thickens.
Add vanilla extract, lemon zest, and nutmeg and stir to combine.
Spoon into individual glasses or serving bowls and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
Dust with a little cinnamon before serving.

name: Greek Roasted Green Beans

ingredients.item: Four cups of diced green beans

method: Take a large pan.
Add the chopped onions and olive oil to it.
Mix the ingredients well.
Add the chopped garlic into the pan.
Add the tomatoes, oregano, salt, black pepper, granulated sugar, thyme,
and smoked paprika into the pan.
Cook the ingredients well.
Add the diced green beans to the mixture.
Add the vegetable stock into the pan.
Mix the ingredients well.
Place a lid on top of the pan.
Cook the green beans for ten to fifteen minutes.
Dish out the food when the green beans are done.
Garnish the dish with chopped parsley on top.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Roasted Vegetables

ingredients.item: One tablespoon of crushed red pepper
Three cups of mixed vegetable pieces
Half cup of savory summer sprigs

method: Take a large pan.
Add the olive oil and chopped onions into it.
Cook the onions until they turn light brown in color.
Add the minced garlic into the pan.
Cook the mixture for five minutes.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper.
Add the spices and all the vegetables.
In a bowl, crush the cherry tomatoes and add the salt.
Dish the mixture out in a plate when the vegetables are done.
Add the crushed tomatoes into the pan.
Cook the tomatoes for ten minutes or until they turn soft.
Add the vegetable mixture into the pan again.
Add the rest of the ingredients into the pan and bake it for about
fifteen minutes.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Salad Cracker

ingredients.item: Two teaspoons of freshly ground black pepper
A quarter cup of red wine vinegar
One cup of red-orange bell pepper

method: Take a small bowl.
Add the olive oil and minced garlic into it.
Mix in the bread slices.
Bake the slices for ten minutes.
Dish out the bread slices when they are done.
Take a large bowl.
Add the English cucumber, Kalamata olives, red-orange bell pepper,
cherry tomatoes, and feta cheese into the bowl.
Mix everything well and set it aside.
Take a small bowl.
Add the olive oil, red wine vinegar, kosher salt, minced garlic,
freshly crushed black pepper, fresh oregano, and dried oregano.
Mix everything well.
Pour this dressing on the prepared salad.
Mix everything well and add it on top of the toasted bread
slices.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Salad Recipe with Lemon Dressing
method: Toss all components in a large mixing bowl with the required size of
dressing until well combined.
Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and whisk until smooth.
If required, season with more salt and pepper.

name: Greek Salad Recipes

ingredients.item: Two teaspoons of freshly ground black pepper
A quarter cup of red wine vinegar
One cup of red-orange bell pepper

method: Take a small bowl.
Add the olive oil and minced garlic into it.
Mix it well and spread it on the bread slices.
Add the parmesan cheese on top of the slices.
Bake the slices for ten minutes.
Dish out the bread slices when they are done.
Take a large bowl.
Add the English cucumber, Kalamata olives, red-orange bell pepper,
cherry tomatoes, and feta cheese into the bowl.
Mix everything well and set it aside.
Take a small bowl.
Add the olive oil, red wine vinegar, kosher salt, minced garlic,
freshly crushed black pepper, fresh oregano, and dried oregano.
Mix everything well.
Pour this dressing on the prepared salad.
Mix everything well and add the toasted bread slices to the side.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Salad Skewers
method: To make the feta marinade, mix the feta, olive oil, lime juice, cloves,
dill, and parsley in a small cup.
Season with salt, then mix in the sauce until the cheese is fully
wrapped.
Enable for fifteen minutes of resting time.
Pour feta, olives, grape tomatoes, and cucumber onto large forks to
make skewers.

name: Greek Salad Snack Skewers
method: To make the feta marinade, mix the feta, canola oil, lime juice, cloves,
dill, and tarragon in a small cup.
Add salt and pepper, then mix in the sauce until the cheese is fully
wrapped.
Allow for fifteen minutes of resting time.
Layer feta, artichokes, grape tomatoes, and cucumber onto small forks
to make skewers.

name: Greek Salad with Chicken
method: For a large baking dish or two independent salad dishes, add the
lettuce.
Cut the meat, tomatoes, salad, olives, cucumber, and feta cheese
together.
Add the wine vinegar, olive oil, cloves, oregano, butter, salt, and
black pepper to a small container to create the dressing.
Cover and move well with the cap until combined and mixed.
To satisfy, sprinkle with more salt and sugar, and peppers.
Sprinkle over the salad with the dressing and mix to adjust.

name: Greek Salad with Edamame
method: In a big mixing bowl, combine the vinegar, oil, pepper, and salt.
Toss in the iceberg lettuce, edamame, peppers, tomato, tzatziki,
spinach, artichokes, and onion.

name: Greek Salad with Homemade Vinaigrette
method: In a mixing bowl, mix some of the components except the olive oil.
Slowly drizzle in the olive oil, constantly whisking as you pour until
the dressing is caramelized.

name: Greek Salad with Lettuce and Lemon Garlic Dressing
method: Collect the required components.
If the cucumber's skin is too thick, peel it.
It should be sliced into thin rounds.
Slice the tomato after cutting the stem and heart.
Cut the radishes and onion very finely.
Bell peppers can be sliced into strips.
In a large mixing bowl, mix the cucumber, cabbage, sliced bell
peppers, and onion.
Combine the feta cheese and artichokes in a mixing dish.
Merge the olive oil, lime juice, cloves, and oregano in a small cup. To
mix ingredients, whisk them together.
Toss the veggies in a bowl with lemon juice and vegetable oil.
Place sliced lettuce in separate salad bowls or sheets and top
with the salad mixture.
Season with coarse salt and black pepper to taste.

name: Greek Salad

ingredients.item: medium tomatoes, cored and cut into wedges
cucumbers, peeled and sliced 1/2 inch thick

method: In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, vinegar, and oregano. Season with salt and pepper. In a large bowl, combine the cucumbers, cheese, romaine, tomatoes, and olives. Toss the salad with the dressing and serve at once.

name: Greek Savory Snacks
method: Use the hands, crush the feta cheese and place it in a pan.
Cottage cheese, salt, and pepper, eggs, are added and blend until well
mixed.
Place the Phillo sheet on a broad workpiece and take one sheet at the
moment.
On each, spray some sunflower oil.
At 356°F, turn on the stove.
At the start of a stripe, insert a teaspoon of the combination and then
"cover" it, placing the extreme left end on the right-hand side.
Go forward and roll it into a triangle and place it on a baking sheet
coated with paper towels.
Sprinkle some olive oil in the pan of all of them when done.
Bake for 20 minutes or before it turns golden.

name: Greek Scramble
method: Beat the eggs, feta, dairy, half teaspoon salt, and ¼ teaspoon spice in a
large mixing bowl to merge; set it aside.
Place the butter in a pan nonstick deep fryer or stainless cast iron pan
over medium-high heat until glinting.
Insert the onions, sprinkle with salt, and simmer for about five
minutes, stirring periodically, until softened.
Add the spinach once fully wilted, and any moisture has evaporated,
flipping continuously for around three minutes.
Lower the heat to moderate and put in the combination of the eggs.
Let sit uninterrupted, 2 minutes, before the eggs just begin to set
around the sides.
Move the placed eggs from the sides towards the middle using a
slotted spoon.
Back into a layer, scatter the raw eggs.
Repeat for a cumulative cooking time of around four to six minutes,
moving the prepared eggs from the sides to the middle every thirty
seconds until almost complete.
Drop the heat from the skillet and place the tomatoes in it.
Serve with bread or baked pita bread right away.

name: Greek Scrambled Eggs
method: Beat the eggs, feta, dairy, half teaspoon salt, and ¼ teaspoon
spice in a large mixing bowl to merge; set it aside.
Place the butter in a pan nonstick deep fryer or stainless cast
iron pan over medium-high heat until glinting.
Insert the onions, sprinkle with salt, and simmer for about five
minutes, stirring periodically, until softened.
Add the spinach once thoroughly wilted, and any moisture has
evaporated, flipping continuously for around three minutes.
Lower the heat to moderate and put in the combination of the
Let sit uninterrupted, 2 minutes, before the eggs begin to set
around the sides.
Move the placed eggs from the sides towards the middle using
a slotted spoon.
Back into a layer, scatter the raw eggs.
Repeat for a cumulative cooking time of around four to six
minutes, moving the prepared eggs from the sides to the middle every
thirty seconds until almost complete.
Drop the heat from the skillet and place the tomatoes in it.
Serve with bread or baked pita bread right away.

name: Greek Sesame Bread Rings
method: Take a large bowl.
Add the sugar, yeast, and lukewarm water into the bowl.
Mix well and keep aside until bubbles are formed.
Add the flour and salt into the mixture.
Knead the dough well and start forming ring structures from the dough
mixture.
Add the sesame seeds on top of the rings and place the rings on a
baking tray.
Bake the dish for about thirty minutes.
Your dish is ready to be served.
7 Greek Breakfast Ladenia (Flatbread with Tomatoes)

name: Greek Sheet Pan Chicken Dinner
method: Heat the oven to 400F.
Mix all the components in a shallow saucepan with the marinade.
Use a baking dish to put sliced vegetables.
Position the veggies in and around the meat.
Pour all the vegetables into the marinade and brush on the chicken.
Organize the mixture equally and nestle around the sheet pan with
sliced lemons.
Put in the oven and bake for 30-35 minutes or until the chicken hits
165 degrees and the vegetables are slightly orange.
Squeeze over the fried dish with sliced lemons.
Spray with olive oil with grated cheese and Kalamata.

name: Greek Skillet Orange Fillo Cake
method: In a small saucepan, mix 2 cups glucose, liquid, and spices.
Bring to the boil and cook for ten minutes on high heat.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Take the phyllo plates from the box and set them aside.
As you prepare the rest of the ingredients, let the broken phyllo dry
out just a little.
In a food processor or blender, mix orange juice, lime zest, eggs,
yogurt, olive oil, ¼ cup sugar, and icing sugar.
Mix at high speed for 2 minutes or until foamy.
Orange slices can be used to decorate the edge of the cake.
Bake for 45 minutes in an oven and bake until the surface is crispy
and the filling is ready.
Put down for at least 1 hour, just until the syrup has absorbed
the majority of the liquid.

name: Greek Slow Cooked Lamb Gyros

ingredients.item: A quarter cup of lemon juice
Half cup of sliced red onion
A quarter teaspoon of fresh nutmeg

method: Take a large pan.
Add the olive oil and garlic into the pan.
Add the oregano, tomato paste, smoked paprika, nutmeg, chili powder,
thyme, and salt.
Add the vegetable broth, lemon juice, and lamb pieces into the pan.
Slow down the stove and cook for about thirty minutes.
Cook the ingredients well for about fifteen minutes.
Bake the flatbreads for about two to three minutes.
Cut the flatbreads in between to form a pouch structure.
Add the cooked mixture into the flatbread and line it with tzatziki
sauce, romaine lettuce, sliced tomatoes, and red onions.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Souvlaki

ingredients.item: Half cup of chopped fresh chives
One teaspoon of mixed spice powder

method: Take a large bowl.
Add all the ingredients in the bowl.
Mix the marinade well.
Roast the chicken pieces over a grill pan.
Dish out when the chicken pieces are golden brown on both sides.
Serve the souvlaki with pita bread on the side.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Spanakopita Spring Rolls

ingredients.item: One pack of spring roll wrappers
Half teaspoon of freshly grated nutmeg
A quarter cup of chopped onion
A pinch of crushed black pepper

method: Take a large pan.
Add the olive oil into the pan.
Add the onions and garlic when the oil heats up.
Cook the onions until they turn soft.
Mix the eggs and add the chopped spinach into the pan.
Cook the ingredients until the spinach is wilted.
Add the feta cheese, milk, black pepper, salt, and freshly grated nutmeg
into the pan.
Cook the ingredients for about five minutes.
Switch off the stove and let the mixture cool down.
Add the mixture on the spring roll wrappers and roll it.
Deep fry the spring rolls until they turn golden brown.
Dish out the spanakopita when it is done.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Spanakopita

ingredients.item: Two teaspoons of fine sea salt
Half cup of unsalted soft butter
A quarter cup of ice water
Half teaspoon of freshly grated nutmeg
A quarter cup of chopped onion
A pinch of crushed black pepper

method: Take a large bowl.
Add the flour and sea salt into the bowl.
Mix the ingredients well and add the eggs, water, and softened butter
into the bowl.
Mix all the ingredients well to form a dough.
Take a large pan.
Add the olive oil into the pan.
Add the onions and garlic when the oil heats up.
Cook the onions until they turn soft.
Mix the eggs and add the chopped spinach into the pan.
Cook the ingredients until the spinach is wilted.
Add the feta cheese, milk, black pepper, salt, and freshly grated
nutmeg into the pan.
Cook the ingredients for about five minutes.
Switch off the stove and let the mixture cool down.
Roll out the dough and lay half of it in a round baking dish.
Add the cooked mixture to the dough and cover the mixture
with the rest of the dough.
Bake the spanakopita for about twenty to twenty-five minutes.
Dish out the spanakopita when it is done.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Spiced Lamb Cutlets with Smoked Aubergine

ingredients.item: One cup of crumbled feta cheese

method: Take a large bowl.
Add the pepper, aubergine pieces, mixed spice, lemon pepper, fresh
dill, dried oregano, and salt into the bowl.
Mix all the ingredients well.
Add the lamb pieces and olive oil to the bowl.
Mix the ingredients well and add the chopped garlic and the rest of the
ingredients.
Mix all the ingredients of both the bowls together.
Add the mixture to a greased baking dish.
Grill the lamb and aubergine for twenty-five to thirty minutes.
Dish out the lamb and aubergine when done.
The dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Spinach Rice
method: Add the oil over medium-high heat in a wide pan, add the onions
softly for 7 minutes until it is soft but not golden brown.
Cook, tossing, till the spinach has softened, and all moisture has
vanished.
Add the spinach and quarter the dill.
Add the flour, liquid, and tomato paste to the mixture, and bring to a
simmer.
Lower the heat and boil, sealed, for 20 minutes or until all water has
been absorbed and consumed by the rice.
When required, add more water.
Add the remaining lime juice, then dill, and sprinkle with salt.
Chapter 4: Greek Delicious Dinner Recipes

name: Greek Stuffed Cucumber Bites
method: Cucumbers should be sliced into 3” bits.
Make a well in each cucumber with a melon baller or a fork.
Toss together tomatoes, artichokes, feta, tarragon, lime juice, garlic,
canola oil, and oregano in a big mixing bowl.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Cover cucumbers with salad combination.
If needed, top with more dill before serving.

name: Greek Stuffed Grape Leaves

ingredients.item: One cup of chopped red onions

method: Take a large pan.
Add the butter and chopped onions into the pan.
Cook the onion until it turns soft.
Add the garlic and ginger as well as the beef mince, tomatoes, and
tomato paste.
Cook the beef well for about ten minutes.
Add the granulated sugar, cooked rice, salt and pepper.
Mix everything well and dish out.
Clean the grape leaves and add the cooked mixture into it.
Roll the grape leaves.
Add the mixed cheese on top and place the grape leaves on a
greased baking tray.
Steam the grape leaves for about ten to fifteen minutes.
Garnish the grape leaves with freshly chopped parsley leaves.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.item: One pound of green bell peppers
One cup of chopped red onions

method: Take a large pan.
Add the butter and chopped onions into the pan.
Cook the onion until it turns soft.
Add the garlic and ginger as well as the chopped zucchini, chopped
potatoes, tomatoes, tomato paste, and chopped carrots.
Cook the vegetables well for about ten minutes.
Add the granulated sugar, cooked rice, salt, and pepper.
Mix everything well and dish out.
Clean the bell peppers from inside and add the cooked mixture into it.
Add the mixed cheese on top and place the bell peppers on a greased
baking tray.
Bake the bell peppers until the cheese turns light golden brown.
Garnish the bell peppers with freshly chopped parsley leaves.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek-Style Baked Feta
method: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F and modify a tray in the center.
Organize the onions, green peppers, and grape tomatoes at the lower
part of a ramekin or stove dish.
Spray some of the new thyme with 1 teaspoon oregano, chili flakes,
and apply most of it. Drizzle some extra-virgin olive oil with it.
On top of the prepared vegetables, add the feta.
Prepare the leftover dried oregano with both the feta cube, a touch of
chili flakes, and whatever is left of the fresh thyme.
Sprinkle the feta with a thick layer of olive oil and ensure to rub some
of the butter on the edges.
Position the baking sheet on the oven's center rack and bake for 20
minutes.
Serve it with tortilla chips or Spanish toasted bread.

name: Greek-style Baked Pasta
method: Gently sauté the onion in olive oil, for 2-3 minutes over medium heat. Add in the ground lamb and garlic and cook
for 10 minutes, or until the meat cooks well. Stir in the marinara sauce. Season with pepper and salt, to taste.
In a blender, blend 2 cups of the ricotta with the eggs, nutmeg and 1/2 cup of the Parmesan cheese until smooth.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta according package instructions. Drain and set aside in an oiled baking dish.
Add the lamb mixture to the pasta and toss to combine. Pour the ricotta mixture on top and sprinkle with the
remaining Parmesan cheese.
Bake the pasta until the cheese turns golden, 15-20 minutes.

name: Greek-Style Ice Cream
method: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, warm ½ cup of milk, ½ cup of heavy cream, the sugar, eggs, and ¼ cup olive oil.
Cook for about 15 minutes, until the base turns a light yellow and thickens. Do not let it boil.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool down completely. Cover and refrigerate for 40–60 minutes.
When it is chilled, add the remaining ingredients. Mix well.
Churn the mixture in an ice cream maker for 30–45 minutes, until it is thick and creamy. Freeze in an airtight container for at least 4 hours before serving.
Alternatively, to make without an ice cream maker, freeze the mixture in a baking pan in your freezer for 2 hours. Take it out and stir to combine the mixture.
Place it back in the freezer for 1 ½ hours, then freeze and churn again. Repeat until you get an ice cream consistency.

name: Greek-Style Shrimp Cocktail

ingredients.item: (20- to 30-count) wild shrimp, peeled and deveined
finely chopped fresh Greek oregano or dill

method: In a large pot over high heat, bring 8 cups of water to a boil.
Add the shrimp and boil for 2 to 3 minutes, until pink. Drain and cool.
In a food processor, combine the egg, oregano, olives, garlic, and mustard. Blend to combine.
with the processor running on low speed, very gradually add the walnut oil through the feed tube on your food processor.
When it has thickened to a mayonnaise-like texture, blend in the salt and pepper. Serve immediately with the shrimp, or use within 1 day.

name: Greek-Style Stuffed Acorn Squash
method: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Position the squash pieces, split side up, on a wide baking tray; roast
for around thirty minutes until they can only be penetrated with a
To chill, transfer to a cutting board.
In the meantime, in a large saucepan, put the lentils; add water to fill.
Just get it to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer until tender, sealed, for 25 minutes. Withdraw
and put aside.
Simmer the chicken stock in the same frying pan. Insert orzo; cook al
dente according to the box instructions.
Cook meat, crumbling beef, once no longer yellow, eight minutes in a
wide skillet; rinse.
To the skillet, insert lentils and orzo; extract from the heat. Add feta
cheese and Greek spices to two tablespoons; blend well.
Return the stored chicken broth to the saucepan.
Stir in the starch over medium-high heat until it thickens, then
mix into the meat combination.
Quarter squash when cold enough to treat and return to the
baking sheet.
Cover the mixture of meat. Bake for 30 minutes, until the
squash is soft.
Stir with french-fried vegetables and, if necessary, extra feta
before eating.

name: Greek-Style Stuffed Peppers
method: Heat the oil over moderate heat in a large pan.
Insert fennel and onions; continue cooking for ten minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and veggies; cook for one minute longer. Mildly cool.
Break the peppers and save the tops; extract and discard the seeds.
Pour 1 cup of chopped tomatoes into the 6- or 7-quarter rim.
Combine the lamb, rye, 1 cup of feta cheese, olives, and spices in a
large mixing bowl; add the mixture of fennel.
Mix the spoon into the peppers; place in a slow cooker.
Pour the remainder of the crushed tomatoes over the peppers; replace
the tops with pepper.
Cook, wrapped, until peppers are soft, 4 to 5 hours on medium.
Serve with extra feta and minced parsley if needed.

name: Greek Tilapia
method: Brown salmon in oil in wide cast iron or another ovenproof pan.
Integrate the egg, milk, cheese, and cayenne in a shallow saucepan
and spoon over the fish.
Spray with onions, raw cashews, and olives.
Toast, exposed, 10-15 minutes at 425° before the fish only starts to
blister easily with a spoon.
Mix the parsley, lime juice, and peppers in a shallow saucepan and
sleet over the fish.

name: Greek Tomato Fritters
method: Take a large bowl.
Add everything into the bowl and mix well.
Add water into the bowl to form a mixture.
Heat a frying pan and add vegetable oil in it.
Add a spoonful of batter to the pan carefully and cook them for few
minutes.
Dish it out when fritters turn light brown in color.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Tortilla Pinwheels
method: Arrange all of your items ahead of time.
Place the feta cheese and Greek yogurt combination on a tortilla on a
surface or other dry worktop.
Keep a small border from around the surface clear.
The salad vegetables should be uniformly distributed around the
cheese, followed by the oregano and peppers.
Cover the tortilla in bubble wrap and roll it up as tightly as possible.
Place in the fridge for about 30 minutes to firm up.
Remove the tortilla from the wrapper and cut it into 8 even pieces.
Layout flat on a tray to serve.
Chapter 3: Greek Lunch Recipes

name: Greek Tzatziki Dip

ingredients.item: One and a half cups of Greek yoghurt
One tablespoon of chopped fresh dill

method: Take a large bowl.
Add all the dried ingredients into the bowl.
Mix well and refrigerate for ten minutes.
Add the wet ingredients into the bowl.
Mix well.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Vegan Skordalia
method: Take a saucepan.
Boil the potatoes in the saucepan.
Drain the potatoes when done.
Mash the potatoes.
Add the garlic, lemon juice, almond meal, salt, red wine vinegar, and
olive oil into the mashed potatoes.
Mix everything well.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Vegetable Balls with Tahini Lemon Sauce

ingredients.item: Two cups of grated mixed vegetables
One cup of tahini lemon sauce

method: Take a large bowl.
Add the grated mixed vegetables, spices, mint, onion, garlic, and egg
into the bowl.
Mix all the ingredients well and form round ball structures.
Fry the vegetable balls in olive oil until they turn golden brown.
Dish out the balls.
Serve the balls with tahini lemon sauce on the side.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Vegetable Pitas

ingredients.item: A quarter cup of crumbled feta cheese

method: Take a large pan.
Add the olive oil into the pan.
Add the onion and salt into the pan.
Cook the onions well and then add the black pepper into the pan.
Add the mixed vegetables into the mixture.
Add the chopped basil into the mixture.
Cook the ingredients well for about fifteen minutes.
Dish out when the vegetables are done.
Let the meat cool down, and then add the crumbled feta cheese into it.
Mix well.
Heat the pita bread.
Cut a hole into the bread and add the cooked mixture into it.
Garnish the bread with chopped cilantro.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Vegetarian Bamies

ingredients.item: Half cup of chopped fresh thyme
Half cup of chopped fresh oregano
Half cup of chopped fresh chives
One teaspoon of mixed spice powder

method: Take a large pan.
Add the chopped onions and olive oil into it.
Mix the ingredients well.
Add the chopped garlic into the pan.
Add the tomatoes, oregano, bay leaf, salt, black pepper, thyme, smoked
paprika, mix spice powder, and chives into the pan.
Cook the ingredients well.
Add the okra pieces into the mixture.
Add the vegetable stock and water into the pan.
Mix the stew well.
Place a lid on top of the pan.
Cook the stew for ten to fifteen minutes.
Dish out the stew when the vegetables are done.
Garnish the dish with chopped parsley on top.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Vegetarian Meatballs

ingredients.item: mixture of parsley, mint, and dill

method: Heat the oven to 350 °F.
On a parchment-lined baking tray, position the dry kidney beans and
cook for 10-15 minutes till the beans look broken and sound dry to
the touch.
Take them from the furnace and raise the heat of the oven to 370°F.
Over medium-high heat, heat a large pan.
Add two tablespoons of olive oil, cloves, and parsley once it is
warmed.
Sauté for three minutes, or until transparent and moderately soft,
stirring regularly.
For later usage, remove from the heat and reserve the bowl.
In a mixing bowl, add kidney beans alongside cloves, parsley, salt,
black pepper, pepper flake, oregano, and process a few times into a
slim meal, becoming cautious not to mix thoroughly.
When squeezed between your fingertips, insert the quinoa, rice,
tahini, chopped parsley, basil, dill, and rotate to mix until a contoured
dough shape.
Add a little more starch and shake to mix, whether it is too
tacky or muddy.
Squeeze out heaping volumes of 1-1 ½ tablespoon and shape
carefully using your palms into tiny pieces.
Patting these first and tossing them afterward. Place in a dish
and chill in the fridge for fifteen minutes.
Chilling is acceptable, but during skillet frying, it means the
meatball holds together longer.
In a small container, put the remaining ¼ of a cup of starch.
Reheat the pan and transfer the remaining olive oil to the pan.
Brush the meatballs with powder and return them to the skillet
and sauté for a few minutes, rotating the meatballs slightly to either
surface to get a soft crust.
Then move to the oven and cook for 20 minutes or until the
sides are nicely browned and gently dry to the fingertips.

name: Greek Vegetarian Moussaka

ingredients.item: Two tablespoons of fresh chopped dill
A pinch of crushed black pepper

method: Take a large bowl.
Add the eggplant, zucchini pieces, potatoes, baby spinach into a bowl.
Mix the olive oil, salt, and crushed black pepper into the bowl.
Bake the ingredients in an oven for about twenty minutes.
Take a large pan.
Add the olive oil and onion into the pan.
Cook the onions until they turn soft.
Add the minced garlic into the pan.
Cook the ingredients well.
Add the feta cheese, salt, and black pepper into the pan.
Mix all the ingredients well and add the chopped dill into the
Add the baked vegetables into the pan and then mix everything
Add the tomato sauce and béchamel sauce on top of the
vegetable mixture.
Bake for another ten minutes.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Vegetarian Rice

ingredients.item: Three cups of chopped mixed vegetables
A quarter cup of dried mint
Two tablespoons of chopped fresh dill

method: Take a large saucepan.
Add the water into the pan and season it with salt.
Boil the water and then add the rice into the water.
Boil the rice and then drain it.
Take a large pan.
Add the olive oil and heat it well.
Add the chopped onions into the pan and cook it until it turns soft and
fragrant.
Add the chopped garlic into the pan.
Add the vegetables, tomato paste, lemon juice, salt, and crushed black
pepper into the pan.
Cook the ingredients for about ten minutes.
Add the boiled rice into the pan and mix well.
Add the dried mint and chopped dill into the pan.
Place a lid on top of the pan.
Cook the rice for about five minutes on low heat.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Vegetarian Soutzoukakia
method: Put a reasonable quantity of water in a jar with the chickpeas and
continue cooking.
Wash them before they break for twelve hours or overnight.
Dump, washed off when prepared.
Move and pulse a bit to a mixing bowl, ensuring you do not produce a
paste.
Put the olive oil, baking soda, cilantro, lime zest, lime juice, diced
onion, grated cloves, coarsely chopped mint, salt, and black pepper in
a bowl transfer to the mixture. Rigorously blend.
Form the combination into oval-shaped meatballs and excavate in the
starch.
Over moderate to low heat, put a large pan and heat the oil let it get
heated. Insert the meatballs cautiously in quantities and cook until
they become golden.
To drain, switch to a cooking pan filled with paper towels.
Put the olive oil, the finely diced onion, the bay leaf, the spices, the
dried oregano, the mustard, the hot pepper, the crushed garlic cloves,
the granulated sugar, and the tomato sauce in a shallow bowl.
Garnish with the grated onion, salt, and black pepper.
Reduce the heat and add the crispy meatballs to the dish.
Cover and cook with a cap for ten minutes.
Present with boiling basmati rice, rosemary, canola oil, and
clean oregano.

name: Greek Vegetarian Stuffed Zucchini
method: Heat the oven to 350 degrees F.
Break each zucchini in quarter lengthwise, use a fork, scrape much of
the skin, preserving ½-inch-thick cores.
Chop quarter the flesh thinly sliced; waste the remainder flesh or save
it for some purpose.
Cover a baking dish with the zucchini pellets; brush with salt and
black pepper.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes before the zucchini begins to soften.
In the meantime, over a moderate flame, heat the oil in a large skillet.
Add the sliced zucchini, onions, cloves, paprika, and two tablespoons
of oregano; boil for approximately 3 minutes, stirring regularly, until
the onion begins to soften.
Stir in the quinoa, olives, tomatoes, and feta, and extract from the
heat. Split the zucchini cores equally.
Turn to broil the oven and put a rack 8 inches away from the heat.
Broil the cores of packed zucchini till the edges are finely
browned for four to six minutes.
Stir with 1 teaspoon of the leftover oregano.

name: Greek Veggie Balls With Tahini Lemon Sauce
method: Position the spring onions, parsley, cloves, oregano, sun-dried
tomatoes, dates, fennel seeds, salt, and black pepper in the spice
grinder bag. Work until finely chopped.
In the food processor, add the flax seeds, cornflour, almond flour, and
lime juice and pulse until mixed.
Insert the black-eyed pods into the food processor till the beans are
crushed, though not purified, for a few seconds.
Take the mixture out of the food processor and cool it for thirty
minutes.
In the meantime, mix all the tahini with lime juice, cloves, and black
pepper to create Tahini Citrus Sauce.
Add more water, according to the ideal consistency, to form a
delicious sauce.
Spray with paprika, which has been smoked.
Preheat the furnace to 375 F.
Use your palms to roll vegetarian balls into 24 golf-sized balls, and
put them on a cookie dish coated with cooking spray. Position it on
the oven's top-shelf.
Cook for 60 minutes, until the vegetarian balls are baked, and
the surface is lightly browned.
Use Tahini Citrus Sauce to serve.

name: Greek Walnut Cake

ingredients.item: A quarter teaspoon of ground cardamom

method: Take a large bowl.
Add the cake batter and mix all the ingredients.
Make the batter and pour it into a baking dish.
Make sure the baking dish is properly greased and lined with parchment
paper.
Add the walnut mixture and mix up all the ingredients.
Bake the cake.
Dish it out when done.
Make the vanilla and cream frosting by first beating the butter and
cream until they turn fluffy.
Add in the rest of the ingredients and beat for five minutes.
Add the vanilla and cream frosting on top of the cake.
Make sure to cover all the sides of the cake with frosting.
Cut the cake into slices.
The dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek White Bean Stew

ingredients.item: Half cup of chopped fresh thyme
Half cup of chopped fresh oregano
Half cup of chopped fresh chives
One teaspoon of mixed spice powder

method: Take a large pan.
Add the chopped onions and olive oil into it.
Mix the ingredients well.
Add the chopped garlic into the pan.
Add the tomatoes, oregano, bay leaf, salt, black pepper, thyme, smoked
paprika, mix spice powder, and chives into the pan.
Cook the ingredients well.
Add the white beans into the mixture.
Add the vegetable stock and water into the pan.
Mix the stew well.
Place a lid on top of the pan.
Cook the stew for ten to fifteen minutes.
Dish out the stew when the beans are done.
Garnish the dish with chopped parsley on top.
Your dish is ready to be served.

name: Greek Yogurt Pancakes

ingredients.item: Butter or olive oil, for the skillet

method: Mix together the flours, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.

In a separate medium bowl, whisk together the yogurt, egg, and milk. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients in three or four increments, whisking until smooth. Cover with plastic wrap and let the batter rest in the refrigerator for at least 15 minutes or up to overnight.
When ready to make the pancakes, in a nonstick skillet, melt 2 teaspoons butter over medium-high heat, tilting the pan so the butter is evenly distributed over the surface.

Pour the batter into the skillet, a ladleful at a time, to form pancakes that are about 4 inches (10 cm) in diameter. Don’t overcrowd the skillet. Flip the pancakes when the underside is golden brown and continue to cook until both sides are golden. Transfer to a plate, dabbing each pancake with a little butter as you stack them. Continue until the all the batter has been used, adding butter to the skillet between batches as needed. Serve hot.

name: Greek Yogurt Ranch Sauce

ingredients.item: cup (80 ml) strained fresh lemon juice
Scant 1 tablespoon Dijon or Greek mustard
cup (80 ml) Greek yogurt, preferably full-fat
chopped fresh herbs of your choice, such as dill, parsley, oregano, and/or mint
Salt and freshly ground black pepper

method: Put the lemon juice in a medium bowl and whisk in the mustard.
While whisking, drizzle in the olive oil in a slow, steady stream and whisk until the mixture emulsifies. Whisk in the yogurt until smooth, followed by the garlic and herbs.
Season to taste with salt and pepper. Use immediately or place in a jar with a tight-fitting lid and refrigerate for up to 3 days.
To reconstitute, shake vigorously.

name: Greek Ziti
method: Boil the chicken stock and the oregano in a large skillet once half a
cup of liquid is left in the dish, about three minutes.
Mix in the cubes of chicken, protect and withdraw the pan from the
flame.
In the cooking liquid, let the meat heat until just cooked, about eight
minutes.
Heat the ziti until cooked, about 13 minutes, in a big pot of hot, salted
liquid.
Flush and mix the pasta with the meat, feta, lime juice, pepper, salt,
and coriander mixture.
Stir until you have fully melted the cheese. Drop the cherry tomatoes
Mix and serve hot.

name: Greek Zucchini Balls (Kolokithokeftedes)
method: Take a large bowl.
Add the grated zucchini, spices, mint, onion, garlic, and egg into the
Mix all the ingredients well and form round ball structures.
Fry the zucchini balls in olive oil until they turn golden brown.
Dish out the balls.
Serve the zucchini balls with Greek yoghurt on the side.
Your dish is ready to be served.
Chapter 6: The Famous Greek Vegetarian Recipes
Greek vegetarian dishes are extremely wondrous and loveable. Following are
some amazing Greek vegetarian recipes that are rich in healthy nutrients, and
you can easily make them with the detailed instructions list in each recipe.

name: Green bean salad with mustard seeds and tarragon
intro: This salad – offering a good balance of clean freshness from the beans with the punchy complexity of the herbs and spices – works in plenty of contexts. Try it next to Two-Potato Vindaloo (page 18), along with Fried Lima Beans with Feta, Sorrel and Sumac (page 214), or as a side dish with grilled lamb chops.

ingredients.item: coriander seeds, roughly crushed with a mortar and pestle
mild fresh red chile, seeded and finely diced

method: Fill a medium saucepan with cold water and bring to the boil. Blanch the green beans for 4 minutes, then immediately lift them out of the pan and into iced water to refresh. Drain and dry.
Bring a fresh pan of water to the boil and blanch the snow peas for 1 minute only. Refresh, drain and dry. Use the same boiling water to blanch the peas for 20 seconds. Refresh, drain and dry.
Combine the beans, snow peas and peas in a large mixing bowl.

Put the coriander seeds, mustard seeds and oil in a small saucepan and heat up. When the seeds begin to pop, pour the contents of the pan over the beans and peas. Toss together, then add the nigella seeds, red onion, chile, garlic, lemon zest and tarragon. Mix well and season with salt to taste.
Just before serving, gently fold the chard leaves, if using, in with the beans and peas, and spoon the salad onto plates or into bowls.

name: Green Beans with Freekeh and Tahini

ingredients.item: cup/70 g cracked freekeh, rinsed and drained

method: Place all the ingredients for the sauce, along with ½ teaspoon salt, in a bowl.
Whisk until combined and set aside.

Fill a saucepan with plenty of water—it should be two-thirds full—a nd bring to a boil. Add the freekeh and ½ teaspoon salt, turn down the heat to medium, and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes, until the freekeh is cooked through but still retains a bite. Drain and refresh well under cold water.
Transfer the freekeh to a large bowl and set aside.

Fill a large saucepan with plenty of cold water and add 2 teaspoons salt. Place over high heat, bring to a boil, then add the beans. Boil rapidly for 4 minutes, until the beans are just cooked, then drain and refresh under cold water. Pat the beans dry well before adding them to the freekeh. Pour the tahini sauce over the freekeh and beans and mix gently so that the beans are completely coated. Just before serving, mix in the chervil and the walnuts along with the chile flakes.

name: Green bok choy with dried shrimp
subtitle: kai yang chao cai 开洋炒菜
intro: This wonderful, quick stir-fry was taught to me by master chef Hu Zhongying in the kitchens of the Hangzhou Restaurant. A handful of dried shrimp lends an umami richness to the juicy greens; a little stock will further enhance their flavor, but you can use water if you don’t have any to hand. The recipe may sound similar to the stir-fried cabbage with dried shrimp here, but it has a totally different flavor and mouthfeel. In Chinese markets, especially in places near the coast such as Ningbo and Zhoushan, you will find great tubs of dried shrimp of different colors and sizes, from the moon-white papery variety to orange-pink creatures as large as the fresh saltwater shrimp that are eaten as a main ingredient. In this dish I use the smallish pink ones that are known as “open ocean,” “sea rice” and “rice shrimp” in different dialects. They are sold in most Chinese food shops and keep well in the fridge or freezer. If you wish, you can thicken the cooking juices with potato starch to give it a glossy, professional finish. The same method can be used for other vegetables, such as choy sum and spinach. If you have the very thick, stalky kind of choy sum, chop it into chopstickable pieces before cooking.

ingredients.item: potato starch mixed with 1 tsp cold water (optional)

method: Put the shrimp and Shaoxing wine in a bowl and cover with hot water; soak for at least half an hour. Quarter the bok choy lengthways, then cut it into chopstickable lengths.

Heat the oil in a seasoned wok over a high flame. Add the shrimp and stir-fry until they smell delicious, then add the bok choy and stir until the leaves have wilted. Pour the stock or water around the sides of the wok. Bring to the boil, cover and cook for a minute or so to heat through. Remove the lid, season with salt and stir briefly to allow the liquid to reduce. Give the potato starch mixture a stir and mix into the wok, if using. Serve.

Soak the shrimp as in the main recipe. Cut the zucchini into fairly thin slices. Stir-fry the shrimp in oil until fragrant, add the zucchini and stir-fry until piping hot. Add a little stock and season with salt; cover the wok and cook for a short while until tender. Lift the lid to reduce the liquid, then serve.

Soak the mushrooms in boiling water for half an hour to reconstitute, then trim off any knotty bits. Stir-fry with green bok choy. The slippery-crisp mushrooms are a nice contrast to the juicy vegetables.

name: Green Coconut Chutney
intro: I can’t get enough of this mildly spiced chutney, pictured.

time.prep: 10 MINS, PLUS SOAKING TIME IF USING DRIED COCONUT FLAKES
time.total: 10 MINS, PLUS SOAKING TIME IF USING DRIED COCONUT FLAKES2 MINS

ingredients.item: grated fresh coconut, frozen shredded coconut or dried coconut flakes (if using dried, rinse and soak in 250ml/1 cup water for about 30 minutes before using)
piece of ginger, peeled and roughly chopped

method: Toast the chana dhal in a dry frying pan over a medium–high heat until fragrant and lightly browned, about 1½–2 minutes. Transfer to a plate to cool slightly.

Put the coconut, coriander (cilantro), green chillies, ginger and toasted chana dhal in a blender or spice grinder and blend with 125ml (½ cup) of water. This should be a runny chutney so add more water until the consistency is right. Add the sugar and lemon juice and season with salt.

Heat the oil in a small pan over a high heat. When hot, add the mustard seeds. When they begin to pop, reduce the temperature to medium–high and stir in the white urad dhal. Let the dhal toast until light brown – about 1 minute should do. Stir in the asafoetida and curry leaves and let this all sizzle in the oil for about 20 seconds. Your kitchen will smell amazing.
Pour the spiced oil over the chutney to serve.
tips: *If you are gluten-free, please check the asafoetida packaging as some brands contain wheat flour.

name: Green couscous
intro: A good-looking and even better tasting side salad (pictured on page 257). It has strong flavors and is extremely healthful but still feels light and comforting. Serve it with Poached Baby Vegetables (page 12) or with fish. Adding some feta will make it a bit more substantial.

ingredients.item: unsalted pistachios, toasted and roughly chopped

method: Place the couscous in a large bowl and cover with the boiling water or stock. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and leave for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, fry the onion in the olive oil on medium heat until golden and completely soft. Add the salt and cumin and mix well. Leave to cool slightly.
To make the herb paste. Place all the ingredients in a food processor and blitz until smooth.
Add the herb paste to the couscous and mix everything together well with a fork to fluff it up. Now add the cooked onion, the pistachios, green onions, green chile and arugula and gently mix.
Serve at room temperature.

name: Green feta salad with watercress mayonnaise
intro: Always buy the best-quality cheese you can find. Authentic feta is made entirely of sheep milk cheese, and must have been produced in Greece in order to receive the name—otherwise, it’s just a poor-substitute hard cheese.

ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper
small handful of fresh mint leaves
(For the dressing) handful of fresh watercress, roughly chopped

method: In a food processor, pulse the dressing ingredients together until well combined. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Put the feta, peas, spinach, and mint in a bowl, and toss gently to mix. Season with a little pepper if you wish. Transfer to a serving bowl, and serve with the watercress mayonnaise and lemon wedges on the side.

name: Green Fettuccine with Scallop and Parsley Sauce

ingredients.item: sea scallops, cut horizontally into 1-inch slices
Parmesan cheese, plus additional for serving

method: Over medium heat and using a stainless-steel or enameled skillet, cook 1/4 cup parsley and shallots in butter for 5
minutes. Add wine and reduce over high heat until about 6 tbsp. of liquid remain.
Add the scallops and cook for 1 minute. Add both evaporated milk and heavy cream; simmer for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add 1 cup Parmesan cheese, 1/3 cup minced parsley and nutmeg. Salt and pepper to taste.
Cook noodles according to package directions; drain and toss with unsalted butter. Transfer the pasta to a heated
serving dish and ladle on the sauce.
Toss gently and sprinkle with 2 tbsp. of minced parsley and Parmesan cheese.

name: Green Fresh Spring Rolls

ingredients.item: minced scallion (white part only), plus 5 scallions (green parts only)
dried wood ear, oyster, or shiitake mushrooms, cut into ¼-inch (6 mm) strips
sweet potatoes, boiled until tender and cut into sticks about the size of french fries
fresh herbs (such as mint, Asian basil, and/or perilla leaves)
fresh mustard greens (cải cay or juk gai choy; see Note), thick part of stems removed and rinsed

method: Cut the tofu into ½-inch (1 cm) thick “steaks.”

In a medium skillet, heat ¼ cup (60 ml) of the vegetable oil over medium heat. When hot, cook the tofu in batches until golden brown on both sides (5 to 8 minutes per side). When done, transfer tofu to a paper towel–lined plate to drain. Let cool completely, and then cut the steaks into ½-inch (1 cm) wide sticks.

Discard remaining oil in skillet, add remaining 1 tablespoon vegetable oil and heat over low heat. Add 1 tablespoon of minced scallion (white part) and cook and stir until golden brown (about 1 minute).

Add half the carrot and cook and stir until softened (1 to 2 minutes). Add mushrooms, ½ teaspoon of the sugar, stock powder, and salt, and stir well. Add the prepared tofu, gently toss to combine, and then transfer to a plate to cool.
In a medium bowl, combine remaining carrot with remaining 1 teaspoon sugar and vinegar. Mix well and set aside for 10 minutes.

Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Prepare a bowl of ice water and set nearby. Drop scallions (green part) into boiling water for 30 seconds, or until wilted. Use a wire spider or slotted spoon to transfer to bowl of ice water. Drain and set aside.
Cook the dried vermicelli noodles following package instructions.
Place tofu-mushroom mixture, sweet potatoes, fresh herbs, noodles, mustard greens, and green scallions on separate plates.

Place one mustard green leaf, dark side down, on a flat work surface or cutting board. Place a bit of each filling ingredient—rice vermicelli, 1 tablespoon of tofu-mushroom mixture, 1 sweet potato stick, pickled carrot, and fresh herbs—on one end of the leaf. Lift up the end with the fillings over the fillings, and then gently roll it up.

Use a leaf layer of blanched scallion as a string to tie up the roll, and then repeat with the remaining mustard leaves, fillings, and scallions. Lay the rolls parallel to each other and trim off the top and bottom edges to make them uniform in size.
In a small saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over low heat. When hot, add 1 tablespoon of minced scallion and cook and stir until fragrant (about 30 seconds).
Add fermented soybean sauce, ¼ cup (50 g) of sugar, peanut butter, and water, and stir well. Simmer until smooth and thickened (1 to 2 minutes).
Transfer to a dipping sauce bowl, stir in sesame seeds, top with minced chili pepper (if using) and serve with green spring rolls.

name: Green gazpacho
intro: There are a million recipes around for gazpacho, which is by far my favorite cold soup. This one, a green

ingredients.item: fresh green chile (or less if you don’t want it too hot)

method: To make the croutons. Preheat the oven to 375°F. Cut the bread into ¾-inch cubes and toss them with the oil and a bit of salt.
Spread on a baking sheet and bake for about 10 minutes, or until the croutons turn golden and crisp. Remove from the oven and allow to cool down.

Roughly chop the celery, bell peppers, cucumbers, bread, chile and garlic. Place in a blender and add the sugar, walnuts, spinach, basil, parsley, vinegar, oil, yogurt, most of the water, half the ice cubes, the salt and some white pepper. Blitz the soup until smooth. Add more water, if needed, to get your preferred consistency. Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning.
Lastly, add the remaining ice and pulse once or twice, just to crush it a little. Serve at once, with the croutons.

name: Green lentils, asparagus and watercress
intro: I have since realized that fresh asparagus actually withstands quite a lot and can impart its flavor over

ingredients.item: garlic clove, peeled salt and black pepper
semi-mature pecorino (or one of the more full-bodied varieties of

method: Wash the lentils in cold water, then place in a saucepan with plenty of fresh water and bring to the boil. Simmer for 15 minutes, or until the lentils are just cooked but haven’t started to disintegrate.
While the lentils are cooking, put half the watercress, the parsley, olive oil, vinegar, garlic and some salt and pepper into a food processor. Blitz until smooth. Pour into a bowl.
As soon as the lentils are cooked drain them well and mix them, while still hot, with the watercress dressing. Taste and adjust the seasoning; you will probably need more salt.
Cook the asparagus in simmering salted water for 2 to 3 minutes; drain. Cut the spears into roughly 2 ½-inch-long segments.
You can serve the salad warm or at room temperature. Toss together the lentils, asparagus and most of the remaining watercress. Add pieces of cheese as you plate the salad.
Drizzle with walnut oil, if using, and garnish with the reserved watercress. Serve with wedges of lemon.

name: Green Mango, Cabbage, and Jicama Salad
intro: Many people assume that an unripe mango is not ready for prime time, but to me, it’s an opportunity to make gỏi xoài (mango salad). The traditional rendition includes cooked shrimp and fatty pork, but I’ve found that dropping the proteins not only makes the salad less fussy (read: faster to make) but also shifts the focus to the produce and highlights the tropical flavor combinations that are central to Vietnamese cooking. The decluttered version is lighter, brighter, and easily adapted for vegan diners.

ingredients.item: small jicama, peeled and cut into medium-thick matchsticks
peeled, pitted, and cut into thick matchsticks (double the width of the jicama)
to 2 tablespoons fish sauce, or 1½ tablespoons soy sauce plus ¼ teaspoon fine sea salt
small garlic clove, put through a press or minced and mashed
Thai or small serrano chile, finely chopped, with seeds intact
packed coarsely chopped fresh mint or basil
finely chopped unsalted roasted peanuts or cashews

method: In a large bowl, combine the cabbage, jicama, and mango and set aside. (The vegetables and fruit can be stored, covered, in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.)

Using a fine rasp grater, such as a Microplane, zest the lime directly into a small bowl. Squeeze the lime to get 2 tablespoons of juice; if you’re short, add vinegar to make up the difference. Add the lime juice to the zest and then add 1½ tablespoons sugar. Stir to dissolve the sugar, then taste and add more sugar, if needed, for a strong tart-sweet finish. Add enough of the fish sauce to arrive at a bold, salty-tangy finish. Add the garlic and chile, stir, and then set the dressing aside.
Toss the vegetables and fruit well with the dressing, mint, and peanuts, until the cabbage and jicama soften slightly. Transfer to a shallow serving bowl, leaving excess dressing behind.

name: Green Olive Loaf

ingredients.item: recipe Short-crust pastry or 1 lb / 500 g store-bought pastry
ingredients.original: 1 recipe Short-crust pastry or 1 lb / 500 g store-bought pastry

ingredients.item: Jerusalem artichokes, peeled and cut into ¾-inch / 2-cm cubes
ingredients.original: 1⅓ lb / 600 g Jerusalem artichokes, peeled and cut into ¾-inch / 2-cm cubes
5 oz / 150 g feta cheese, broken into pieces

ingredients.amount: salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.original: salt and freshly ground black pepper

method: Lightly oil a 9-inch / 23-cm tart pan with a removable bottom. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the pastry to 1/16 to ⅛ inch / 2 to 3 mm thick. Use the pastry to line the pan, pressing it well into the corners and the sides and allowing it to spill over the edge by at least ¾ inch / 2 cm. This excess will be trimmed later. Prick the base with a fork in a few places, then leave the tart shell to rest in the fridge for at least half an hour.

Preheat the oven to 170°C. Cut a circle of waxed paper greater in diameter than the base plus the sides of the tart pan. Tuck it in the pastry shell and fill with dried beans or rice. Blind bake the shell for 35 minutes, then remove the paper and the beans or rice (you can keep them and reuse indefinitely for baking blind). Return the pastry shell to the oven and bake for a further 5 to 10 minutes, until lightly golden and thoroughly cooked. Remove from the oven and leave to cool.

While your pastry is resting and baking, prepare the filling. Place the artichokes in a saucepan, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil with a little salt. Lower the heat and simmer for 15 minutes, until tender. Drain and leave to cool.

Cut the chard leaves off the stalks, then coarsely chop the leaves and stalks, keeping them separate. Heat the oil in a large frying pan, add the stalks, and fry for 2 minutes, then add the leaves and the rosemary. Sauté for 6 to 8 minutes, depending on how woody the chard is. It should wilt completely. Remove from the heat, stir in the lemon juice, garlic, and some salt and pepper and leave to cool.

Whisk together the heavy cream, crème fraîche, eggs, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Spread the artichokes, chard, and feta over the base of the pastry shell, arranging them so that all the ingredients are visible. Pour the custard mixture on top. Make sure that you don’t fill the tart to the rim. You want bits of the filling to show above the custard. Carefully transfer the tart to the hot oven and bake for 15 minutes. Then cover with aluminum foil, keeping it away from the tart’s surface, and bake for a further 45 minutes, until the filling is set. If the top is still pale at this point, remove the aluminum foil and leave the tart in the oven for a few extra minutes.
Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly. Break off the excess pastry and take the tart out of the pan. Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Green onion and herb salad
intro: This is lovely alongside all sorts of meat: it’s as green- and herb-lled as a spring

ingredients.item: 1½-inch/4cm piece of ginger, peeled and  nely chopped (¼ cup/25g)
green onions, cut into quarters lengthwise and  nely chopped (2¼ cups/150g)
small Lebanese cucumbers (or ½ small English cucumber), unpeeled and cut into ½-inch/1cm dice (1 cup/150g)
green bell pepper, cut in half lengthwise, seeded, and cut into ½- inch/1cm dice (1 cup/150g)

method: To make the dressing, place the ginger in a pestle and mortar and crush to form a rough paste. Mix with the lemon juice, oil, and salt and set aside.
Place the green onions, cucumbers, bell pepper, mint, and cilantro in a large bowl. Add the dressing, and toss well. Add the nigella seeds and salt to taste, toss again, and serve.
Curried lentil, tomato, and coconut soup
Pictured on this page, bottom

I like the rough texture of this soup—with the lentils still holding their shape and the cilantro distinct—but you can also blitz it before serving, if you prefer things smooth. This soup can be made 4 days in advance if kept in the fridge, and up to
1 month if frozen.

Cilantro stems can all too often be thrown away, but they shouldn’t be—they have the texture of chives and taste, unsurprisingly, of cilantro. Serve this soup with lime wedges, if you like, for a citrusy kick.

name: Green Onion Soup

ingredients.item: lb/900 g green onions, white and green parts, if possible a large variety with a thick bulb
tbsp/50 ml olive oil, plus extra to finish
medium heads garlic, cloves peeled and halved lengthwise (2 oz/60 g)
cups/300 g fresh or defrosted frozen green peas
medium zucchini, cut into ⅜-inch/1-cm dice (1½ cups/200 g)
cups/80 g flat-leaf parsley leaves, coarsely chopped
cup/60 g kashk (or mix a scant 3 tbsp/40 g crème fraîche and a generous 3 tbsp/20 g grated
cup/20 g mint leaves, chopped finely grated zest of ½ lemon salt and black pepper

method: Cut the white part of the green onions into slices ⅔-inch/1.5-cm wide, the green part into segments 1-inch/2.5-cm wide, and keep them separate.

Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the olive oil, the white parts of the green onions, the garlic cloves, ½ teaspoon salt, and some black pepper and sauté for 10 to 15 minutes, until the vegetables are soft and have lost some of their harshness. Add the green parts of the green onions and the bay leaves and continue cooking for about 10 minutes. Add the peas and zucchini and cook for another 5 minutes.

Remove half the vegetables from the pan and set aside. Cover the remaining vegetables with the stock, bring to a boil, and simmer for 3 minutes. Remove the bay leaves, add the parsley, and blitz in a food processor or with a handheld blender. Return the reserved vegetables to the pan and warm them up before stirring in the kashk.

Transfer the soup to individual bowls and sprinkle with the mint and lemon zest. If you are not using the kashk, spoon a teaspoon of crème fraîche into each bowl. Finish each serving with a drizzle of oil.

name: Green pancakes with lime butter
intro: Some lime butter will probably be left over. Keep it in the fridge and then smear it over a baked sweet potato.

ingredients.item: unsalted butter, at room temperature grated zest of 1 lime
egg white olive oil for frying

method: To make the lime butter. Put the butter in a medium bowl and beat it with a wooden spoon until it turns soft and creamy. Stir in the rest of the ingredients. Tip onto a sheet of plastic wrap and roll into a sausage shape. Twist the ends of the wrap to seal the flavored butter. Chill until firm.
Wilt the spinach in a pan with a splash of water. Drain in a sieve and, when cool, squeeze hard with your hands to remove as much moisture as possible. Roughly chop and put aside.
Put the flour, baking powder, whole egg, melted butter, salt, cumin and milk in a large mixing bowl and whisk until smooth.
Add the green onions, chiles and spinach and mix with a fork.
Whisk the egg white to soft peaks and gently fold it into the batter.

Pour a small amount of olive oil into a heavy frying pan and place on medium–high heat. For each pancake, ladle 2 tablespoons of batter into the pan and press down gently. You should get smallish pancakes, about 3 inches in diameter and ³

8 inch thick. Cook for about 2 minutes on each side, or until you get a good golden- green color. Transfer to paper towels and keep warm. Continue making pancakes, adding oil to the pan as needed, until the batter is used up.
To serve, pile up three warm pancakes per person and place a slice of flavored butter on top to melt.

I would either start a meal or end it with this salad. It is an ideal palate-cleanser with its robust yet refreshing herb flavors. Or, you could serve it to balance a long-cooked or rich main course, such as the
Smoky frittata on page 96. Another idea is to add spoonfuls of buffalo ricotta to transform the salad into a more substantial starter.
It is essential to dress the salad as you serve it and not a second earlier: the delicate herbs wilt in an instant when they come in contact with the acidic dressing.

name: Green Pani
intro:
Green pani (green water) is delicious poured into pani puri. It can be made in minutes, though leaving it in the fridge for about 2 hours before serving will allow the flavours to develop. I don’t strain the pani but some people do. I’ll leave that up to you.

Green pani has other uses besides pani puri. Try steaming rice using the green pani instead of water. If you don’t feel like making it, you can purchase excellent-quality green pani at Asian grocers.

ingredients.item: green chillies (or more if you like things spicy)

method: Put all the ingredients up to the salt in a blender with 250ml (1 cup) of water and blend for 1 minute. If you’re in a rush for the deliciousness, you could add 250ml (1 cup) more water and run it all through a sieve, check for seasoning and enjoy immediately. For best results and a stronger flavour, place the paste with the additional water in the fridge for about 1 hour. Then run it through a sieve and check for seasoning. Season with salt and perhaps a little chilli powder. If you prefer a sweeter flavour, stir in some more sugar.

Your green pani is now ready to serve. It can also be frozen for up to 3 months to use later. I always have some on hand because my pani puri parties just tend to happen late at night after a few beers with friends without any planning.

name: Green papaya, beef, and noodle salad
intro: A vibrant, Vietnamese-inspired noodle salad, this meal makes for a refreshing lunch. Green papayas are underripe fruit that feature in many Southeast Asian salads—if you can’t find papaya, green mango works just as well.

ingredients.item: rice vermicelli or mung bean noodles
medium green papaya or mango, peeled, seeded, and cut into matchsticks
(For the dressing) finely grated fresh ginger
(For the dressing) Vietnamese nuoc mam or Thai fish sauce
(For the dressing) fresh red chiles, seeded and finely chopped

method: Preheat the broiler to high. Trim any fat from the steak and broil for 3–4 minutes on each side, or until browned but still pink in the center. Set aside for at least 15 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Meanwhile, soak the vermicelli in boiling water until softened, or as directed on the package. Drain, rinse in cold water, then cut into manageable lengths with kitchen scissors. Set aside.
Mix together the lemongrass, ginger, cilantro, nuoc mam, mint, lime juice, sugar, and chiles.
Pile the noodles, papaya, and steak on a serving dish and add the dressing. Toss lightly together and scatter with peanuts before serving.

name: Green soybeans with snow vegetable
subtitle: xue cai mao dou 雪菜毛豆
intro: This simple, gorgeous recipe is typical of Shanghainese home cooking. Bright green soybeans are tossed in a wok with pickled snow vegetable and slivers of pork and bamboo shoot. It’s the kind of dish that, served with plain rice, can be a meal on its own. Shanghainese cooks tend to add a little bamboo shoot for crunch and extra umami, but it can seem like a waste to break open a package of brined bamboo for such a small amount, so feel free to omit this if you wish. There are other variations on the theme of this dish; some people prefer not to add ginger and garlic, while others might pep it up with a little dried chilli and Sichuan pepper, added to the wok with the garlic and ginger. Vegetarians may simply omit the pork. The same method works well with peas and fava beans.

ingredients.item: shelled green soybeans, fresh or frozen

method: Cut the pork into thin slices, then into slivers. Do the same with the bamboo shoot, if using. Bring a pan of water to the boil, blanch the bamboo shoot and rinse it in cold water, then drain. Boil the soybeans for 2 minutes until hot and tender.

Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a seasoned wok over a high flame, add the soybeans and stir-fry over a medium flame until piping hot. Remove from the wok and set aside. Return the wok to a high flame with 1 tablespoon oil, add the pork and stir-fry until the strips have turned pale. Add the Shaoxing wine and allow it to evaporate. Add the ginger and garlic and stir-fry for a few seconds until you can smell them. Tip in the snow vegetable and bamboo shoot and stir-fry until hot and fragrant. Stir in the beans and season with the sugar, a good pinch of pepper and salt if you need it; the salty pickled vegetable may mean you don’t. When everything is piping hot and smells wonderful, remove from the heat and stir in the sesame oil. Serve.

This is a typical Hangzhou supper dish. Cut 100g lean pork into 1cm cubes, add 1 tsp Shaoxing wine and ⅛ tsp salt and mix well. Cut 40g Sichuan preserved vegetable and 40g bamboo shoot into smaller cubes. Boil 250g frozen green soybeans until hot and tender. Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a seasoned wok over a high flame. Add the pork, stir-fry until cooked through, then remove and set aside. Stir-fry the preserved vegetable and bamboo shoot until they smell delicious. Add the beans. When everything is piping hot, add the pork and season with salt. Off the heat, stir in 1 tsp sesame oil and serve. Frozen peas can be used instead of soybeans, and can be added directly to the wok.

name: Green Sticky Rice with Coconut

ingredients.item: dried green sticky rice flakes (see Note)
shredded young coconut or 1 ounce (28 g) dried coconut flakes, rehydrated (see Note)

method: In a medium bowl, combine dried green sticky rice with coconut milk, mix well, and let sit for 10 minutes.
In a medium skillet, combine shredded coconut and sugar, and cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, for about 2 minutes.
Add rice and cook and stir until all rice flakes come together to make one sticky gelatinous mass (3 to 5 minutes). Remove from heat.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal-size portions and spoon each onto the center of a rice cracker. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve.

name: Green Tabbouleh
subtitle: Tabbouleh khadra
introduction:
Tabbouleh is so ubiquitous across the Levant that we didn’t feel the need to publish our own traditional take on this well-known salad. Rather than tweaking the bulgur and parsley version, we’ve offered three rather novel variations: this green one with kale, another that uses rice instead of bulgur (this page), and a wintry-citrus-purple version (see this page).

Sami’s mother used to make a version of this to take on picnics in Jericho in the summer months. The salad was kept fresh by the addition of a few cubes of ice, wrapped up in newspaper, to the bottom of the basket. Picnics were, typically, an elaborate affair. Preparations would start the day before, with everyone coming together to chop and arrange for the movable feast.

This is as nice throughout the year as a side or part of a spread, as it is eaten on a picnic outdoors. The dressing is lemony and sharp, so it works particularly well with oily fish or rich meatballs.

Playing around: The kale can be replaced by all sorts of other cabbages, depending on what’s in season; white cabbage, hispi (aka “pointed”) green cabbage, spring greens, and young cauliflower with its tender leaves attached all work very well.

Getting ahead: You can prepare the salad in advance but don’t add the dressing until serving, and shred (rather than chop) the herbs—this will prevent them from bruising and losing their color. The difference between chopping and shredding, for us, is the number of times the knife goes through the herb leaf. Chopping sees it getting cut many times—chop, chop, chop—whereas shredding sees the knife just go through once, in a cleaner motion.

ingredients.item: ⅓ cup/50g bulgur (regular or whole wheat, for extra nuttiness)
ingredients.original: ⅓ cup/50g bulgur (regular or whole wheat, for extra nuttiness)

ingredients.item: ⅓ cup/80ml lemon juice (from about 2 lemons)
ingredients.original: ⅓ cup/80ml lemon juice (from about 2 lemons)

ingredients.item: 1½ cups/100g kale leaves (or 6⅓ oz/180g if starting with kale on the stalk, which you then need to remove), finely shredded
ingredients.original: 1½ cups/100g kale leaves (or 6⅓ oz/180g if starting with kale on the stalk, which you then need to remove), finely shredded

ingredients.item: 4 cups/75g parsley (mostly leaves, not stems), finely shredded
ingredients.original: 4 cups/75g parsley (mostly leaves, not stems), finely shredded

ingredients.item: 3 large (or 6 regular) green onions, very thinly sliced (¾ cup/60g)
ingredients.original: 3 large (or 6 regular) green onions, very thinly sliced (¾ cup/60g)

method: Place the bulgur in a small bowl, pour in the boiling water, then set aside for about 20 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed.
To make the dressing, whisk together all the ingredients with ¾ tsp of salt and a grind of black pepper, and set aside.
Transfer the bulgur to a large mixing bowl and add all the remaining ingredients. Pour the dressing over the top, toss well, and serve.

name: Green tahini sauce

ingredients.item: flat-leaf parsley leaves, finely chopped if making by hand
ingredients.original: ½ cup / 30 g flat-leaf parsley leaves, finely chopped if making by hand

method: In a bowl, thoroughly whisk together the tahini, water, lemon juice, garlic, and salt. The mixture should be creamy and smooth. If it is too thick, add more water. Stir in the chopped parsley, then taste and add more salt if needed.

If using a food processor or a blender, process together all the ingredients except the parsley until smooth. Add more water if needed. Add the parsley and turn the machine on again for a second or two. Taste for seasoning.

name: Green Tomato Salsa
method: 1 Cut tomatoes into quarters. Place them on a baking sheet having a
2 Put the baking sheet in the oven. Broil them for 5 minutes.
3 Meanwhile, put the diced onions in a bowl. Fill it with cold water,
and soak for 5-10 minutes.
4 Put the broiled tomatoes to a food processor, and break into pieces.
5 Remove water from onion and mix it with peppers, salt, lime juice,
and cilantro. Then pulse it again until having the desired texture.
6 Season it with more lime juice and salt if needed.
7 Serve immediately, put it in the fridge for 1-2 hours for additional
flavor.

name: Grilled Asparagus, Zucchini, and Manouri

ingredients.item: pink peppercorns, plus extra to garnish
ingredients.original: 1 tbsp pink peppercorns, plus extra to garnish

ingredients.amount: salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.item: salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.original: salt and freshly ground black pepper

method: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Juice the lemons and discard all but 2 of the empty lemon halves.

To clean the artichokes, cut off most of the stalk and start removing the tough outer leaves by hand. Once you reach the softer leaves, take a sharp serrated knife and trim off 3/8 to ¾ inch / 1 to 2 cm from the top of the artichoke. Cut the artichoke in half lengthwise so you can reach the heart and scrape it clean. Use a small, sharp knife to remove all the “hairs.” Immediately rub the heart with a little lemon juice to prevent discoloring. Cut each artichoke half into slices ¼ inch / 5 mm thick. Place in cold water and stir in half the remaining lemon juice.

Drain the artichoke slices and spread them on a baking sheet. Add the remaining lemon juice, the 2 reserved lemon halves, bay leaves, thyme, garlic, peppercorns, wine, and oil. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 45 to 60 minutes, or until the artichokes are tender. Remove from the oven, take off the foil, and let the artichokes cool.
